detailed_descriptions.en: Overview Rollout Inline is a brand new inline skating game created by a solo dev who is passionate about the sport. It aims to scratch the itch for those who have been craving a new , modern , and intuitive inline skating game! Enjoy an immersive single-player experience that offers a simcade gameplay feel all about the sport of Inline skating. Whether you are a real-life blader or someone who enjoys extreme sports games, this one is for you! Built for Controllers Rollout Inline is built for controllers. While the core gameplay, such as steering and spinning, is on the left stick and jumping on the right stick , grinds and cess slides are performed with dual-stick controls , with each stick representing each foot. Feature Overview: Riding, Grinding, Cess Slides, Free Spinning & Flipping, Air Grabs, Toe/Heel Rolls, Handplants, Physics/Momentum-based Movement, Ragdoll, Balancing Mechanics (Optional), Multiple Maps, Intuitive Controls, Replay Editor, Original in-game Music/Radio, Challenges, Progression System, Difficulty Settings. Dual Stick Grinds This allows for a huge grind selection and all the creative freedom you could hope for while offering an intuitive gameplay feel! Alternative controls for spinning can be set up in the settings, unlocking even more control and freedom of movement for your skater! Customization Customize your character and skates in the in-game customization menu! Clothing items get unlocked by progressing in the game. You can freely customize your skates at any time - no unlocks needed! Challenges & Progression System Push your limits in various challenges and level up your maps while unlocking new clothing items to style your skater! Challenges will show up in every map, and once you complete a batch of challenges, your map level increases and a new set of challenges will appear, with each level increasing the difficulty! Challenges from an earlier level are always replayable. Multiple Maps Explore multiple maps with various challenges and features like massive gaps, long rails, vert ramps, pools, and more! 3 maps will be available on the day of the Early Access launch.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Overview

Rollout Inline is a brand new inline skating game created by a solo dev who is passionate about the sport. It aims to scratch the itch for those who have been craving a new, modern, and intuitive inline skating game!

Enjoy an immersive single-player experience that offers a simcade gameplay feel all about the sport of Inline skating. Whether you are a real-life blader or someone who enjoys extreme sports games, this one is for you!

Built for Controllers

Rollout Inline is built for controllers. While the core gameplay, such as steering and spinning, is on the left stick and jumping on the right stick, grinds and cess slides are performed with dual-stick controls, with each stick representing each foot.

Feature Overview:

Riding, Grinding, Cess Slides, Free Spinning & Flipping, Air Grabs, Toe/Heel Rolls, Handplants, Physics/Momentum-based Movement, Ragdoll, Balancing Mechanics (Optional), Multiple Maps, Intuitive Controls, Replay Editor, Original in-game Music/Radio, Challenges, Progression System, Difficulty Settings.

Dual Stick Grinds

This allows for a huge grind selection and all the creative freedom you could hope for while offering an intuitive gameplay feel! Alternative controls for spinning can be set up in the settings, unlocking even more control and freedom of movement for your skater!

Customization

Customize your character and skates in the in-game customization menu! Clothing items get unlocked by progressing in the game. You can freely customize your skates at any time - no unlocks needed!

Challenges & Progression System

Push your limits in various challenges and level up your maps while unlocking new clothing items to style your skater! Challenges will show up in every map, and once you complete a batch of challenges, your map level increases and a new set of challenges will appear, with each level increasing the difficulty! Challenges from an earlier level are always replayable.

Multiple Maps

Explore multiple maps with various challenges and features like massive gaps, long rails, vert ramps, pools, and more! 3 maps will be available on the day of the Early Access launch.
